cement noun

Vatican, Parvum verborum novatorum lexicum, s.v. cemento

lithocolla, lithocollae f.

noun, first declension

Recorded for modern cemento in the Vatican’s public abridgement. The unmarked modern stem vowels are not claimed to have independently established quantities.
